protocol: Site 0 (after the first transformer block, before final LayerNorm) was selected after looking at v3 confirmation data. V4 is the held-out test of that choice, not a predeclared v3 site selection. Freeze the v3 nuisance-controlled encoder, λ=1, fit seed 41101, test seed 51203 and decoder-null seed 81517. Refit the same 256-episode maps, with 256 independent decoder-test episodes. No tuning or selection on v4 data. Confirmation seed 271829 is new; 1,024 episodes per rock/direction/condition for each of the same three r7 update-29 agents. Matched environment/action RNG, sampled stochastic actions, cached K/V propagation and the matched-norm decoder-orthogonal random controls are unchanged. Bad→Good stops at first target pickup; Good→Bad continues every decision. Smoke uses 8 fit/test/confirmation episodes and the primary agent only.
nuisance_features: Nuisance design: 25-cell rover-position one-hot (24 reference-coded columns), 100-step decision-index one-hot (99 columns; reset reference), previous-action one-hot (12 columns plus reset reference), current sensor-symbol one-hot (2 columns plus NONE reference), and 7 already-sampled indicators computed from preceding executed actions and observed positions. Total 144 nuisance columns, plus 7 beliefs and an intercept. No reward, hidden quality, or future event enters the regression. No additional nuisance features; fixed layout is constant. One-hot reference coding avoids dummy/intercept redundancy. Counterfactual sensor-pair replay skipped to keep the final CPU iteration focused.
